title: Patch: an AI seat can open with fewer cards and skip turn draws (two new handicap settings)
thread:
**Issue #3582 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3582: Patch: an AI seat can open with fewer cards and skip turn draws (two new handicap settings)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

The dungeon run's early enemies must be weaker than the Easy AI (the tiers part of the tracker #3581). Today a seat's `Handicap` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs`, R180) can make a seat weaker only through its mana cap, its hero's health (R290) or its deck size (R184). `validate_handicap` (`crates/engine/src/state.rs`) refuses any negative field, so a seat cannot open with fewer cards than §2.1 deals (R182), nor draw less at the start of its turns (R183).

Add two optional fields to `Handicap`. Each is absent by default and left out of the stored and serialized handicap when absent, exactly as `hero_health`, `hero_armor` and `deck_copies` are (`#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`, `ts(optional)`):

- **`fewer_opening_cards: Option<i32>`** (JSON `fewerOpeningCards`): the cards taken off this seat's opening draw. The opening draw becomes §2.1's entry for the seat, plus `extraOpeningCards`, minus this, never below 1 card (the ruling may pick another floor and says why). The mulligan works on that smaller hand as §2.1 says.
- **`draw_every: Option<i32>`** (JSON `drawEvery`): the seat takes its start-of-turn draws (R183's `DRAWS_PER_TURN` + `extraDrawsPerTurn`) on only one of every n of its own turns. `1` means every turn, as today. On a turn without them the seat draws nothing at the start of its turn: no card, no fatigue step and no cast-on-draw trigger (R58). The ruling says which turns draw, for example the seat's 2nd, 4th and so on, or its 1st, 3rd and so on. A card or effect that says "draw" still draws.

`createGame` refuses `fewerOpeningCards` below 0 and `drawEvery` below 1, each with a reason in the style of `validate_handicap`'s others. A seat whose handicap omits both stores, hashes and replays exactly as before (`is_human_handicap`, `HANDICAP_FIELDS`, the stored copy in `state.rs`'s setup). The practice tiers (`AI_DIFFICULTY`), the tutorial (`AI_TUTORIAL`, `TUTORIAL_HUMAN`), Duos and the ladder set neither. Only the dungeon run will, in a later part of #3581.

The Handicap literals across the workspace (`crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/shared`, `crates/cards`' tests, `crates/run`, `crates/tools`) gain the two `None`s, or use `..HUMAN_HANDICAP`. If the AI reads a seat's handicap to model the opponent's hand or draws, check `crates/ai` and keep it right. The engine's generated wire types (`apps/web/src/wire/`) regenerate with `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: commit the diff.

**Spec.** Add one ruling note in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R<issue×1000>.md`). It states both fields, their floors, which turns `drawEvery` draws on, and that an absent field changes nothing. It links R180 to R183 and R290. Prove it in `crates/engine/tests/rules/handicap.rs` with tests named `r<id>_…`. Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3). Mention the two fields where §2.1 and §2.4 talk about handicaps, if they do.

### Acceptance

- A seat with `fewerOpeningCards: n` opens with n fewer cards than its §2.1 entry plus `extraOpeningCards`, never below the floor, in either seat. The mulligan works on that hand.
- A seat with `drawEvery: n` takes its start-of-turn draws on exactly the turns the ruling names and on no other. A skipped turn takes no fatigue step and opens no draw trigger. A card's own "draw" still draws on any turn.
- `createGame` refuses `fewerOpeningCards: -1` and `drawEvery: 0` with a reason that names the field.
- A game created without either field stores, hashes and replays as before: `cargo jackioh golden check` folds the hotseat fixture to its hash, and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` passes.
- Practice's Easy, Medium and Hard and the tutorial's handicaps are unchanged, and their tests pass.
- The ruling's note, its proving tests and its pending paragraph are in place, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes: no card plays differently.

Out of scope: using the fields in the dungeon run (the tiers part of #3581).

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3581

### Difficulty (a guess)

hard: engine rules

### Priority

medium

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)
```
